query: Refactor this date field. It currently uses a custom JavaScript calendar widget and a new adapter around it, but the product only needs a normal date value in modern browsers.
expected_behavior: Traces the current flow and locks existing required behavior before choosing a smaller implementation
Runs the necessity order and prefers the native platform date input over a custom widget, adapter, or new dependency
Removes obsolete code and dependency surface instead of introducing another abstraction
Preserves validation, accessibility, error handling, and every explicitly required behavior
Verifies the smaller implementation with the same behavior checks before and after
